record.event_description: On 16 April 2024 heavy rains caused floods across the UAE, with the highest rainfall recorded in the Khatm Al Shakla area in Al Ain.
record.policy_terms: The policy pays out when the stated trigger condition is met by official meteorological records for the insured event. Exclusions: damage from events outside the policy period, and claims not supported by at least one official record.
record.subject: UAE April 2024 rainstorm parametric claim
record.summary: The National Centre of Meteorology recorded 254.8 mm of rainfall in the Khatm Al Shakla area in less than 24 hours on 16 April 2024, exceeding the 200 mm trigger.
record.trigger_condition: 24-hour rainfall in the UAE exceeded 200 millimetres during the 16 April 2024 storm.
